link.$description: Link. Component tokens reference semantic tokens; a literal here is a decision this component owns, and the description is why.

destructive-foreground-hover.$description: Hover for the destructive link. The semantic layer has no danger-hover text role, so this follows the rule the link role itself follows — hover moves toward the primary text colour, darker in light and lighter in dark — and so gains contrast on hover instead of fading (the previous /80 alpha lost it).

underline-offset.$description: Underline gap, em-relative so an inline link keeps the same proportion in a caption and in a heading. Clears descenders in Qeet Text without detaching from the word.
